_meta.source: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census, table 98-10-0002-01 (population by census subdivision). Centre points are approximate locations of each municipality's main shopping area, placed by hand.
_meta.use: Out-of-town shopping destinations for Niagara Falls residents. Each town pulls in proportion to its population relative to Niagara Falls (94,415).
_meta.seeds: detour_factor and highway_kmh convert straight-line distance beyond the city's edge into road distance and time.
